decisions.summary: Separate supported observations from conflicts and unresolved applicability.
decisions.concern: Legal and operational decisions require verified evidence and human review.
decisions.chosen: Preserve supported findings and mark unresolved issues and approvals pending.
decisions.source_basis: Captured authority, system records, evidence and source calendar proposals.
decisions.rationale: Unavailable proof or approval cannot establish compliance or an activated deadline.
tradeoffs: The draft retains open questions until owners and reviewers respond.
decisions.downstream_effect: Stage E must render the same states and keep dates tentative.
